[ASSISTANT_SAID] Grand Teton National Park and Yellowstone National Park are two separate parks, although they are adjacent to each other in Wyoming.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Best hiking trails in Yellowstone National Park include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Old Faithful area trails: Observation Point Trail (2.5 miles, 3-4 hours) and Mystic Falls Trail (7 miles, 4-5 hours).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Mammoth Hot Springs trails: Wraith Falls Trail (2 miles, 2 hours) and Beaver Ponds Trail (5 miles, 3-4 hours).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Grand Prismatic Spring Overlook Trail (1.2 miles, 1-2 hours).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Lamar River Trail (6 miles, 3-4 hours).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Mount Washburn Trail (6.2 miles, 4-5 hours).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Seven Mile Hole Trail (10 miles, 5-6 hours).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Natural Bridge Trail (2 miles, 1-2 hours).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Always check the park's website for up-to-date trail information, as trail conditions and access can change.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Bring bear spray, as Yellowstone is home to grizzly bears and black bears.
